decision: Retain terminal target-prefill tail merging with original attention and MTP chunk boundaries. Earlier boundary-only and MTP-only candidates are rejected. Final 32K/133K HTTP turns are exact and faster; short controls are stable.

mtp_only_formatting_equivalence: Formatting changes debug metadata, but all 27 loadable non-NOBITS ELF sections, including host code and the complete HIP fat binary, match the earlier MTP-preserving production build byte-for-byte.

diagnosis.mechanism: A batch crossing the 2048-token selection budget routes earlier queries through packed-head sparse attention, which lacks the dense path's exact causal-tail accumulation. The initial fix restores dense-prefix arithmetic; the final fix below preserves each original subchunk's dispatch and padding.

quality.final_attention_operator: Eleven bulk-versus-split cases are bit-identical, including 1/3/9/11/33/128-row tails, unaligned 2K/32K/64K/133K starts, final-only output and untouched-prefix checks. Existing independent FP64, preparation and graph-position gates pass without tolerance changes.

http_32768.baseline_replay: All six measured branches match the preceding qualified baseline.
http_32768.candidate_replay: The cold prefix and all three measured greedy branches match. The first measured sampled branch differs; qualification stops before its remaining samples or 133K expansion.

mtp_preserving_followup.diagnosis: Reconstructing the actual 34979-token HTTP prompt from a common 32920-token checkpoint gives identical target prefill logits. The initial candidate's sampled tokens and RNG diverge at the frontier after five generated tokens.
mtp_preserving_followup.mechanism: Keep ordinary target chunks at 2048 and merge only a terminal suffix of at most 128 tokens. Within a merged target forward, retain MTP's original 2047-row catch-up, single boundary row and remaining tail; later target residual rows survive earlier predictor writes in existing scratch.
mtp_preserving_followup.actual_prompt_replay: All 128 sampled tokens, RNG states and full-vocabulary target logits match at every committed frontier after preserving MTP shapes.
mtp_preserving_followup.prefill: Existing boundary gates plus 2059/2048 and 2176/2048 pass four full-logit rows per case.
mtp_preserving_followup.http_replay: Cold prefix, warmups, all three greedy branches and all three sampled branches match the qualified baseline, including prompt/output/cache counts and draft acceptance counts.
mtp_preserving_followup.timing_concern: Candidate sampled branch 2 has 1571.9 ms prefill and 3144.0 ms decode, versus 1487.8/3042.1 ms in the baseline. The candidate's post-request available host memory is about 1.7 GiB lower than its preceding branch. No compactions are recorded. The opposite order below improves both modes; a consistent 32K sampled whole-turn gain is not established.

deep_sparse_tail.mtp_only_http_result: Cold prefix and three greedy outputs match at 133295 cached tokens, but sampled branch 1 differs. The later short controls and OpenCode checks were not run for this failed candidate.
deep_sparse_tail.fresh_baseline: The saved qualified production binary repeats the retained cold prefix and sampled branch hashes exactly.
deep_sparse_tail.mechanism: Sparse WMMA's zero probabilities multiplying populated future V lanes do not always round like zero-padded chunk boundaries. Merged projections now keep the original 2048-query attention launches, including each launch's KV load bound and dense/sparse choice. Existing launches of at most 2048 queries keep their dispatch.

retained_http.scope: Production binaries, same toolchain/weights, C1, capacity 196608, seed 73. Thinking-enabled long turns append 2059 tokens, with one warmup and three measured branches per mode. Full HTTP time includes snapshots and decoding; model loading is excluded.
retained_http.long_replay: All 24 measured responses across both arms match the retained baseline's messages, finish reasons and prompt/output/cache counts. Sampled draft and acceptance counts also match. Warmups and cold-prefix messages match. All twelve matched measured branches are faster.
retained_http.output_lengths: 128 tokens except the same 67-token deep sampled branch on both arms.
retained_http.short_and_opencode_replay: All twelve short responses and eight OpenCode HTTP contract cases match. Long history reuses all 134063 prompt tokens on replay; streamed reasoning/tool arguments, tool-result continuation and strict JSON pass.
retained_http.noise: The first deep greedy baseline branch is slower; the median excludes it. All matched branches improve, and snapshot capture is not faster in the deep candidate. This table uses one baseline-first pair; earlier 32K MTP-only experiments are recorded separately and are not retained speed claims.
